text:
Kevin: Hey team — can I swap my Sat (Mar 21) 12:00–18:00 oncall with someone? Last-minute family thing. I can take Sun evening in return.

Kevin: Quick context: there's a minor model rollout scheduled ~14:00 UTC (non-blocking) and a quiet window 13:30–14:30 where we avoid risky infra changes. The only real ask is a short prewarm after handoff and 30m of queue monitoring. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/oncall-prewarm (see section 'model-rollout-warmup'). :pray:

Maya: I can take that Sat block. Happy to do prewarm. Do you have the exact prewarm command?

Kevin: Thanks Maya! Use this:

Kevin: ```
./scripts/prewarm_cache.sh --model rdi/redwood-v1 --duration 900 --rate 50
```

Kevin: Also: if you need admin SSH or KMS access ping Alex. Note: if latency spikes >500ms escalate.

Alex: I can be on standby for sudo/KMS unlocks. FYI infra scheduled a light E2E smoke run at 13:50, should be fine.

Priya: Maya — quick checklist for you: confirm you have access to prod-secrets (IV), run `redis-cli INFO stats` after prewarm to check keyspace hits, and watch the requests/sec graph in Console (route: /routes/generation).

Sam: +1 Maya, thanks for covering. Can you add me to the handoff thread/channel so I can peek in during the warmup window?

oncall-bot: Please remember to update the rota when swapping: `/oncall swap @Kevin -> @Maya 2026-03-21T12:00:00Z/2026-03-21T18:00:00Z`. Rota rules require confirmation in thread.

Maya: Rota updated and DM'd Kevin for any keys. Planning: start prewarm at 13:40, monitor latency and queue depth until 15:00. Will report back in this thread 15m, 30m post-warmup.

Kevin: Awesome — checklist (copying into thread so future readers have it):
- update rota (done)
- notify infra (Alex also aware)
- run prewarm script at T-20m (13:40)
- verify `redis-cli INFO stats` and Console requests/sec
- escalate to Alex if 95th percentile latency >500ms or error rate climbs >1%

Maya: Understood. Will post short confirmation after prewarm and attach the prewarm log snippet.

Sam: Thanks Maya — if you want, I can shadow the monitoring at 14:00–14:30.

Maya: Appreciate it, Sam. Tagging you in the handoff channel once the prewarm starts.

Kevin: Thanks everyone — leaving my phone on in case anything weird pops up. :thumbsup:

Maya: Prewarm started @13:40 UTC. Will paste logs in 5–10m.

Maya: Prewarm finished, logs look clean. `requests/sec` up ~18% during warm period and latency steady. Will leave monitoring until 15:00.

Sam: Saw the bump, looks good from my side.

Maya: All good — handing off formally to infra oncall. Enjoy your family time Kevin! :tada:
